tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250khrid yig gu ru'i dgongs rgyan nyin byed snying po'i khyad par gyi sngon 'gro'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor skabs/ 1$0000300rtsa ba'i bla ma gu ru padma yid bzhin nor bu'i dbu gtsug tu/ ࿌ 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang g.yung drung gling pa dkar gsal sku na smin nyams can/ sku la chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing*/ mgul phur sku sked du 'chang ba/ dbu la paṇa zhwa/ phyag gnyis chos 'chad phyag rgyas padma dkar dmar gyi yu ba nas 'dzin pa'i me tog snyan gong du rgyas pa/ de'i g.yas kyi lte bar shes rab kyi ral gri dang theg dgu'i chos mdzod 'dus pa'i glegs bam/ g.yon par 'chi med bdud rtsi'i tshe bum g.yung drung g.yas su 'khyil bas mtshan pa bsnams shing*/ zhabs zung rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa// de'i spyi bor si tu padma nyin byed sku mdog dkar smug bsgres tshul/ chos gos rnam gsum dang ber phyam can/ dbu la dbang rtags cod pan dmar po gsol ba/ phyag mnyam gzhag gi steng na tshe bum nor bu dbang rgyal gyis mtshan pa 'dzin cing*/ zhabs rdor skyil gyis rin po che'i khri dar zab 'bol gyi steng du bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor pad nyi zla gdan la rig 'dzin rdo rje drag po sku mdog dmar smug zhi khro/ sku stod la me kha lī ljang gu /sham thabs dang bla gos dmar po/ dbu zhwa padma mthong grol/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje dang g.yon gnam lcags kyi phur pa gdengs shing zhabs zung rgyal po rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor pad nyi zla gdan la rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu dmar smug sgeg nyams gzi byin 'bar ba sku stod la me kha lī mchin kha/ sham thabs dkar po/ bla gos dmar po/ dbu zhwa padma kha 'bus mnabs pa/ phyag g.yas gser rdor thugs ka dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag ka pā la bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams shing*/ zhabs zung phyed skyil gyis rol ba/
de'i spyi bor pad nyi zla gdan la padma bde chen gling pa
sogs gzhung ltar bkod par bya'o// zhes pa'ang dbu zur karma ye shes 'byung gnas nas rten bcas bskul ba bzhin mkha' khyab ming ldan gyis bkod pa dge/ //
